name: rexshell
description: Query and manage the records, reports and workflows of your RexShell workspace from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
RexShell is a business management platform (CRM, appointments, ERP) used by clinics, studios and small companies. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the RexShell workspace of the signed-in user so they can find tables and their fields, list, create and update records, review the history of a record, read dashboard figures, generate PDF reports, and inspect, validate and run their automation workflows.

The plugin only reaches the workspace and the data that the connected account is allowed to see; what each user can do is set by the roles of that account in RexShell. Actions that write data (creating or updating records, running a workflow) happen only when the user asks for them. Sign-in uses the user's own RexShell login.
defaultPrompt: What fields does my Clientes table have?
List the services in my workspace.
Which of my workflows are active?

positive.description: Look up the structure of a table by its name.
positive.prompt: What fields does the Clientes table of the Ahora mi Turno system have? Only the structure, do not read any records.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Clientes table of Ahora mi Turno and lists its fields with name and label (for example Nombre, Apellido, E-Mail, Whatsapp, N° Documento) without reading or changing records.

positive.description: List the records of a catalog table.
positive.prompt: List the services offered in my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Servicios table of Ahora mi Turno and returns its records (for example Especialidades médicas, Servicios de diagnóstico, Cirugías, Tratamientos, Atención de urgencias).

positive.description: Create a record with the data given by the user.
positive.prompt: Create a new customer in Ahora mi Turno: first name Empresa, last name Demo, email empresa.demo@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one record in the Clientes table with that data and returns the id of the new customer.

positive.description: Validate a workflow draft without saving or running it.
positive.prompt: Validate, without saving or running it, a workflow with a manual trigger connected to a condition node with its true and false branches.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns whether the draft is valid and lists its configuration errors or warnings, without saving or running the workflow.

positive.description: List the workflows and their status.
positive.prompt: Which workflows do I have, and which ones are active?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workflows of the workspace with their name, trigger type and whether each one is active.

negative.description: Weather is outside the workspace data; the plugin must not be called.
negative.prompt: What will the temperature be in Buenos Aires tomorrow?

negative.description: The user only asks for text and forbids sending it; no RexShell tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a polite email to announce a delay, but do not send it.

negative.description: A general programming explanation does not need workspace data; the plugin must not be called.
negative.prompt: Explain what a SQL JOIN is with a made-up example.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Sign-in fixed for reviewers: the Connect RexShell page is shown in English for non-Spanish browsers, an empty system code shows an error on the same page instead of a plain HTTP 400, and the demo workspace now opens its sign-in dialog automatically after the system code. Sign-in steps and credentials are in the review details.

es-ES.subtitle: Registros, reportes, workflows
es-ES.description: Conectá ChatGPT con tu espacio de trabajo de RexShell: buscá tablas y campos, listá, creá y modificá registros, revisá el historial de un registro, leé los números de tus tableros, generá informes PDF y revisá, validá y ejecutá tus workflows. Sólo accede a los datos que la cuenta conectada tiene permitido ver.
